title: cells add reports every schema problem in one call
action: Refactor validate_new_cell (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/validate.rs) from fail-fast into a collector: gather EVERY schema problem into a Vec<String> in the existing check order, keeping each message's exact current wording. Skip dependent checks when their prerequisite failed (id-dependent pattern/exists checks only when id present and valid; must_haves.truths check only when lane is valid; verify-sentinel check only when verify present). Real IO/Delegate failures still propagate as errors, never collected. Expose the collector (e.g. validate_new_cell_problems -> MR<Vec<String>>); keep validate_new_cell as a wrapper that joins all problems into one Fail::Thrown message separated by " " or "; " so a single-cell `bee cells add` names every problem in one call. Update the batch path in handlers_write.rs (~line 174, AddReportRow) to call the collector and extend the per-cell problems list with every problem instead of only the first Thrown message. Update existing tests in cells/tests.rs that assert first-error-only strings (validate_new_cell_refusals_and_normalize_shape ~line 450, sentinel test ~line 3352) and add a test: a cell missing id, feature, action, verify AND carrying an invalid lane yields all five problems from one validate call, and the batch --stdin path reports the same list per cell.
